name: Vars
source:
A member of the 13th Division. A typical Segitt, he is physically strong but not really intelligent. He forms an efficient duo with Tamako, in which Vars handles field work while Tamako handles investigative work.

[spoiler] Lost his partner in the past, after which he preferred working solo in the field.
Used to work security in Galbara, but got in trouble and left Galbara to join the police force.[/spoiler]
